Commenting on Travel Experiences

Travel Posts

Explore travel posts from around the world, discover local food, traditions, and hidden places, and share your thoughts by leaving a short comment! 🌍📸💬

Explore the travel posts and read about different destinations and travel experiences. Then, choose one post and write a short comment (1–3 sentences) sharing your opinion.

@mia.travels📍 Kyoto, Japan 🇯🇵 ···
🔍

@mia.travelsToday we visited a small restaurant in Kyoto. It was away from the busy tourist streets, so it felt very peaceful. We tried okonomiyaki, a traditional Japanese dish, for the first time. It was delicious! I loved sitting with local people and trying something new.🍜

#Kyoto #Japan #LocalFood #Travel

Ανάρτηση 1/5
@alex.on.the.road📍 Marrakech, Morocco 🇲🇦 ···
🔍

@alex.on.the.roadThe market in Marrakech was amazing! We walked through narrow streets and saw colourful spices, handmade bags and traditional clothes. The market was full of local people, sounds and smells. I bought a small handmade gift for my sister. It was a great way to experience everyday life in Morocco. 🧺

#Marrakech #Morocco #LocalCulture #Travel

Ανάρτηση 2/5
@emma.explores📍 Algarve, Portugal 🇵🇹 ···
🔍

@emma.exploresToday we discovered a quiet beach far from the busy tourist areas. There were only a few people there, and the water was beautiful. We walked along the cliffs and enjoyed the amazing view. I think finding places like this makes travelling more exciting and special! 🏖️

#Algarve #Portugal #HiddenPlaces #Travel

Ανάρτηση 3/5
@noahtravels📍 Sicily, Italy 🇮🇹 ···
🔍

@noahtravelsWe spent the afternoon in a small Sicilian village. The streets were quiet, and we saw old houses and a beautiful little church. Later, we ate arancini, a traditional Sicilian food. They were delicious! I really enjoyed seeing a different side of Italy, away from the big cities. 🍋

#Sicily #Italy #LocalFood #Travel

Ανάρτηση 4/5
@elliots.world📍 Chiang Mai, Thailand 🇹🇭 ···
🔍

@elliots.worldWhat an amazing day! We visited a local festival in Chiang Mai and watched traditional dances and music. People were wearing beautiful clothes and celebrating together. Everyone was very friendly and happy to talk to visitors. It was wonderful to learn about a Thai tradition and experience the celebration with local people. 🎉

#ChiangMai #Thailand #Traditions #Travel

Ανάρτηση 5/5

💬 Leave a Comment

Choose ONE travel post and write a short comment (30-50 words). Write 1–3 sentences. Mention one specific thing from the post, such as the local food, a tradition, a landscape, a hidden place or another special feature of the destination. Give your opinion and a reason.

🔍

Επίλεξε ανάρτηση και γράψε το σχόλιό σου

Example:

I would love to visit Kyoto because I’d like to try okonomiyaki and experience the local culture. I think eating traditional food in a small restaurant would be a great way to discover everyday life in Japan.

Useful expressions:

Πάτησε μια έκφραση για να μπει στο σχόλιό σου.

Criterion2 – Achieved1 – Partly achieved0 – Not achieved
Reference to the post
2 – AchievedClearly refers to a specific detail from the post.
1 – Partly achievedRefers to the post, but the connection is general or unclear.
0 – Not achievedDoes not refer meaningfully to the post.
Cultural/local element
2 – AchievedClearly mentions a cultural or local element, such as food, traditions, landscape, or a special feature of the destination.
1 – Partly achievedMentions a relevant element, but the reference is very brief or unclear.
0 – Not achievedDoes not mention a cultural or local element.
Opinion and justification
2 – AchievedExpresses a clear personal opinion and gives a simple, relevant reason.
1 – Partly achievedExpresses an opinion but gives little or no clear justification.
0 – Not achievedDoes not express a clear opinion or reason.
Language and task completion
2 – AchievedWrites 1–3 clear, understandable sentences and uses appropriate for the level language.
1 – Partly achievedMinor errors or problems with sentence structure, but the meaning is generally clear.
0 – Not achievedFrequent errors make the response difficult to understand or the task is not completed.
